items.statement: Hypervisor construction emits the inherited D-Bus object-added signal and initializes the bootProgressChangeSignal member.
bootProgressChangeEvent parses the changed-property map, looks up BootProgress, extracts its string value, and passes it to updateCurrentHostState.
A SystemInitComplete boot-progress value sets CurrentHostState to Standby.
An OSRunning boot-progress value sets CurrentHostState to Running.
An Unspecified boot-progress value sets both CurrentHostState and RequestedHostTransition to Off.
Any boot-progress value outside the three recognized mappings sets CurrentHostState to Off.
Assigning CurrentHostState emits a state-change log only when the new value differs from the current value.
The signal handler decodes a status-interface string and a string-valued property map, and performs no state update when BootProgress is absent.
The D-Bus match is scoped to /xyz/openbmc_project/state/host0 and BootProgress::interface rather than accepting arbitrary property-change signals.
bootProgressChangeSignal owns a callback capturing this, so each matching D-Bus event is dispatched to the same Hypervisor instance.
An sdbusplus exception while reading the signal is logged and returns before the BootProgress lookup and host-state update.
Unspecified is the only recognized boot-progress branch that mutates both CurrentHostState and RequestedHostTransition; the other branches mutate only current state.
items.description: SystemInitComplete sets the current host state to Standby, OSRunning sets Running, and Unspecified sets both current state and requested transition to Off.
